'''Zensar Technologies Limited''' is an Indian [[publicly traded]] software and services company.<ref name = economict>{{cite news | url = https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/information-tech/ajay-bhutoria-to-take-over-as-zensar-ceo/articleshow/79690943.cms | newspaper = Economic Times | title = Ajay Bhutoria to take over as Zensar CEO| date = 12 December 2020 | access-date = 25 January 2021}}</ref> The company's stock trades on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]].<ref name = bse>{{cite web | url = https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/zensar-technologies-ltd/zensar-tech/504067/ | publisher = Bombay Stock Exchange | title = Zensar Technologies Stock | access-date = 18 February 2020}}</ref> A subsidiary of [[RPG Group]], the company's chairman is [[Harsh Goenka]].<ref name = businesstoday/>

==History==
Zensar traces its origin to 1922 when a [[United Kingdom|British]] [[original equipment manufacturer|original-equipment manufacturing]] firm established a regional manufacturing unit in [[Pune, India]]. The firm evolved to become the Indian manufacturing arm of British computer maker [[International Computers Limited|ICL]], and was renamed ICIM (International Computers Indian Manufacture). In 1963, ICIM listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]]. In 1991, ICIM established a subsidiary company named [[International Computers Limited |International Computers Limited (ICIL)]], with a focus on software. In 1999, the original hardware division of ICIM was shuttered, leaving ICIM/ICIL as a purely software company.

In February 2000, the company renamed to Zensar.<ref name="Natarajan" /> Ganesh Natarajan became CEO in 2001, beginning a 15-year tenure.<ref name="Mumbai-Gold">{{cite web |url=http://www.iitb.ac.in/alumni/en/awards/2017/distinguished-alumnus/dr-ganesh-natarajan|title=Alumni and Corporate Relations|id=Dr. Ganesh Natarajan|website=Indian Institute of Technology Bombay|access-date=13 October 2013 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20181013163657/http://www.iitb.ac.in/alumni/en/awards/2017/distinguished-alumnus/dr-ganesh-natarajan|archive-date=13 October 2018|url-status=live|df=dmy-all}}</ref> From 2000 to 2005, the company focused on [[application management]] for its clients.<ref name="startupzensar">{{cite book | publisher = SAGE Publications India | url = https://books.google.com/books?id=imIlDAAAQBAJ | title = From Start-Up to Global Success: The Zensar Story |date = 26 January 2016|isbn = 9789351508625| access-date = 20 March 2020}}</ref> RPG Group, the Indian industrial conglomerate headquartered in [[Mumbai, Maharashtra]], is the majority shareholder in the company. The company continues to have its headquarters in Pune in Western India.

By 2012, Zensar had approximately 11000 employees servicing 400 clients in over 20 global locations<ref name="Bhide-thesis">{{cite thesis|type=PhD|first1=Sachin Mohan|last1=Bhide|title=Study of change in composition and direction of exports by information technology companies in and around Pune |publisher=Savitribai Phule Pune University|date=2012|others=guide: Dr. M. R. Tambe|chapter=CHAPTER 6: Zensar Technologies Ltd. Case Study |chapter-url=http://shodhganga.inflibnet.ac.in:8080/jspui/bitstream/10603/185937/20/14_chapter%206.pdf |url=http://shodhganga.inflibnet.ac.in:8080/jspui/handle/10603/185937 |url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181014024059/http://shodhganga.inflibnet.ac.in:8080/jspui/bitstream/10603/185937/20/14_chapter%206.pdf|archive-date=14 October 2018|df=dmy-all}}</ref> and at the end of the 2019 financial year earned revenues of over US$550 million.<ref name="zensar1" /><ref name="ForbesI-20170418">{{cite news|title=Zensar Technologies: On the digital highway|work=Forbes India|first1 =Aveek|last1=Datta|date=27 March 2019|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/boardroom/zensar-technologies-on-the-digital-highway/46707/1 |url-status= live| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180320225158/http://www.forbesindia.com/article/boardroom/zensar-technologies-on-the-digital-highway/46707/1|archive-date=20 March 2018|df=dmy-all}}</ref>

Sandeep Kishore was named Zensar's [[CEO]] in 2016, taking over from Ganesh Natarajan,<ref name="Mint-Kishore-1">{{Cite news|url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/uFfhunnEhRZKZXJYjnBEYJ/Zensar-appoints-HCLs-Sandeep-Kishore-as-CEO-and-MD.html|title=Zensar appoints HCL's Sandeep Kishore as CEO and MD|last=Sanjai|first=P.R.|date=2015-12-14|publisher=HT Media Ltd|website=Livemint|access-date=2018-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181011214449/https://www.livemint.com/Companies/uFfhunnEhRZKZXJYjnBEYJ/Zensar-appoints-HCLs-Sandeep-Kishore-as-CEO-and-MD.html|archive-date=11 October 2018|url-status=live|df=dmy-all}}</ref><ref name="Mumbai-Gold"/> with Zensar Technology backers being [[RPG Enterprises]]. In 2015, [[Apax Partners|APAX Portfolio Company]] acquired a stake in Zensar from Electra Partners Mauritius.<ref name="ForbesI-20170418"/><ref name = businesstoday>{{cite web | url = https://www.businesstoday.in/current/corporate/apax-partners-backed-firm-buys-stake-in-zensar-technologies/story/224637.html | publisher = Business Today | title = Apax Partners-backed firm buys 23.2% in Harsh Goenka's Zensar Technologies| date = 9 October 2015 | access-date = 20 March 2020}}</ref>

{{As of|October 2018}}, Zensar Technologies has offices in over 20 countries.<ref name="NDTV">{{cite web|url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/zensar-technologies-ltd_zensartech/reports|title=Zensar Technologies Ltd.|id=Reports - History|website=NDTV Profit|access-date=14 October 2018|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181014173807/https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/zensar-technologies-ltd_zensartech/reports|archive-date=14 October 2018|df=dmy-all}}</ref> It is listed on both the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] (NSE) and the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and is a component of several [[Stock market index|indices]] including the NSE's Nifty 500 and the S&P BSE 500.<ref name="ET-Zensar-20181013">{{cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/zensar-technologies-ltd/infocompanylisting/companyid-13597.cms |website=The Economic Times|title=ET Markets|id=Zensar Technologies Ltd |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20181013045552/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/zensar-technologies-ltd/infocompanylisting/companyid-13597.cms|archive-date=13 October 2018|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}}</ref> In December 2020, Ajay S. Bhutoria was named Zensar's CEO.<ref name = economict/>

Zensar's business is spread between [[North America]], [[United Kingdom]], parts of [[Europe]] and [[South Africa]].<ref name = economictimes>{{cite news | url = https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/zensars-financial-services-focus-pays-off-in-south-africa/articleshow/71789707.cms | newspaper = Economic Times | title = Zensar's financial services focus pays off in South Africa| date = 28 October 2019 | access-date = 20 March 2020 | last1 = Sangani | first1 = Priyanka }}</ref> Zensar's teams work out of 33 global locations, including offices of acquired entities.
